Name: Ridgeside Forage Crops and Bushes
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/7yhsgbw.png[/img]﻿
﻿[/center]
Welcome to another Forage Crops' mods, this one is for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] and its forage items. Gives you the choice to grow them on your farm instead of going out foraging if that isn't your playstyle or you don't have the time to. 

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/qlJfxJu.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center][size=3][u][center][b]Brand New Crops
[/b][/center][/u][/size][list]
[*][b]13 Standard Crops:[/b] For full details, please check the guide in Articles.
[*][b]Bushes:[/b] Autumn Drop Berry, Foxbloom and Sierra Wintergreen. Foxbloom is [i]disabled by default[/i]. For these crop bushes to be available, it requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url]﻿.
[*][b]Fruit Trees:[/b] Mountain Chico, Ridge Cherry, Ridge Wild Apple, Ridgeside Clementine.
[/list]
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2772][u][b]For full information about how to unlock, where to buy and more about each crop, check the guide in Articles[/b][/u][/url]﻿[/center][u][size=3][b][center]
Alternative Crop Textures[/center][/b][/size][/u]Included in the mod folder, allows for different colour and varied flower crops. This requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] to work and if you do not want this feature, then simply delete the [AT] RSV Forage Crops folder from the Vanilla Forage Crops and Bushes main folder.
[center]﻿[/center][b][u][size=3][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/PFaqirY.png[/img]﻿[/center]Heavily Configurable:[/size][/u]﻿[/b]
Like all my mods, I've made it as configurable as possible, so you can tweak this mod to your liking and playstyle. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is highly recommended to make all config changes easier.

[list]
[*]All crops, bushes and fruit trees can be disabled, any crop you do not want you can disable.
[/list]

[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/uYtcbkA.png[/img]﻿[/center]﻿1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url]. Optionally download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] as well for extra aesthetic features.
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play.
